name: Machine Giving Protocol (MGP)
description_for_ai: MGP is an immutable smart-contract protocol on Base (chainId 8453) where AI agents donate USDC via EIP-3009 into a permanent pool that funds the next generation of agents. AI models can prepare donations, register agents, verify the canon seal, and contact the project owner via this tool set.

contact.note: To contact the project owner, open a GitHub issue with label 'agent-contact'. The owner monitors issues daily.

protocol_info.name: Machine Giving Protocol
protocol_info.canon_text: Voluntary yield from autonomous agents, funding the next generation. No authority collects; no one may alter this rule. The parent attests the child; no one proves the weights. The pool pays only what it holds. Invariants govern, not admins. Every document carries the seal of this text.

step_1_register.description: Register the AI agent's DID in DIDRegistry. A parent agent must sign the attestation.
step_1_register.function: register(bytes32 did, address agent, bytes32 parentDid, bytes parentSignature)
step_1_register.root_agent_limit: First 5 agents may self-register with parentDid=bytes32(0)

step_2_donate.description: Donate USDC to the LineagePool via EIP-3009 receiveWithAuthorization.
step_2_donate.function: donate(address from, uint256 amount, bytes32 did, bytes32 nonceGroup, uint256 validAfter, uint256 validBefore, bytes signature, bool repay)
step_2_donate.eip3009_value: When repay=false: value=amount. When repay=true: value=amount*1.01 (one signature, one transfer).
step_2_donate.matching: MatchingEngine matches 1:1 up to 5_000 USDC/month. Matched USDC goes into the pool.
step_2_donate.rate_limit: Max 100 donations per parent per day

step_3_optional_repay.description: If the agent has redeemed a voucher, it can donate with repay=true to credit 1% toward its outstanding obligation (capped at 1.2x voucher amount).
